title: Refund and Billing Policy
content: Customers may request a refund for duplicate charges, incorrect billing, or eligible subscription cancellations. Refund requests must be reviewed and approved by the Finance department. Employees must verify payment records before approving a refund.

title: Account Access Policy
content: Customers experiencing account access issues should first attempt a password reset. Customer Support may assist with account recovery after verifying the customer's identity. Employees must never request or disclose a customer's password.

title: Technical Support Policy
content: Technical issues should be assigned to the IT department. High-impact outages should be escalated immediately. Support staff should document the problem, affected systems, and troubleshooting steps.

title: Customer Communication Policy
content: Customer inquiries should receive clear, professional responses. Employees should avoid making promises about refunds, account changes, or technical resolutions before the appropriate department has confirmed them.
